metas.name: Mean Girls
metas.description: If you loved the sharp teen comedy and iconic high school dynamics of Clueless and 10 Things I Hate About You, this is an absolute must-watch classic.

metas.name: Legally Blonde
metas.description: Shares the same stylish, pink-hued, ultra-charming energy of Clueless, featuring a deceptively smart heroine who stays true to herself.

metas.name: Easy A
metas.description: Like 10 Things I Hate About You, this is a witty, literary-inspired modern teen comedy led by a charismatic and fast-talking protagonist.

metas.name: She's the Man
metas.description: A hilarious teen comedy adapted from Shakespeare's Twelfth Night, perfectly capturing the nostalgic late-90s/early-00s rom-com energy you enjoy.

metas.name: The Princess Bride
metas.description: A quintessential comfort film that perfectly blends fantasy, romance, and meta-comedy, matching the whimsical tone of Dungeons & Dragons.

metas.name: Stardust
metas.description: A wonderfully lighthearted and magical fantasy adventure that fans of Practical Magic and Fantastic Beasts will adore.

metas.name: Knives Out
metas.description: A stellar, star-studded mystery-comedy. Since you already have Wake Up Dead Man on your radar, you must experience the brilliant movie that started the franchise.

metas.name: Glass Onion: A Knives Out Mystery
metas.description: The vibrant, sun-drenched second installment of the Knives Out series delivers high-energy comedy, mystery, and a colorful cast of eccentric characters.

metas.name: Game Night
metas.description: An incredibly fast-paced, laugh-out-loud comedy thriller that matches the witty banter and chaotic crime elements of The Nice Guys.

metas.name: Kiss Kiss Bang Bang
metas.description: Directed by Shane Black (who also directed The Nice Guys), this witty buddy-cop neo-noir comedy features incredible chemistry and sharp dialogue.

metas.name: The Mummy
metas.description: The ultimate comfort adventure movie. It delivers the same perfect blend of fantasy action, historical charm, and comedy as D&D and Jumanji.

metas.name: Free Guy
metas.description: Set inside a video game, this high-energy, feel-good action comedy captures the same playful virtual-world logic as Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle.

metas.name: Love and Monsters
metas.description: A highly underrated, lighthearted post-apocalyptic adventure with great creature designs, humor, and a warm heart, matching Jumanji's tone.

metas.name: Bullet Train
metas.description: A high-octane, neon-soaked action comedy with a colorful ensemble of assassins, sharing the irreverent humor of Thor: Ragnarok.

metas.name: Logan Lucky
metas.description: A delightful, blue-collar heist comedy with a quirky cast of characters, matching the crime-comedy tone of Get Shorty.

metas.name: Hot Fuzz
metas.description: An incredibly clever and action-packed buddy-cop parody that fans of the sharp humor in The Nice Guys will love.

metas.name: Zombieland
metas.description: A laugh-out-loud horror-comedy that doesn't take itself too seriously, appealing to the fun creature-feature vibes of Anaconda.

metas.name: Shaun of the Dead
metas.description: A brilliant romantic comedy with zombies that perfectly balances humor, heart, and light-hearted horror elementals.

metas.name: The Lego Movie
metas.description: Extremely fast-paced, clever, and endlessly funny, matching the hyper-active comedic tone of Thor: Ragnarok and Jumanji.

metas.name: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
metas.description: A visual masterpiece filled with heart, humor, and spectacular comic-book action that matches the fun-spirited heroism of Thor: Ragnarok.

metas.name: Scott Pilgrim vs. the World
metas.description: A stylized, video-game-infused romantic comedy-action film that aligns beautifully with the quirky energy of Night Is Short, Walk On Girl.

metas.name: Death Becomes Her
metas.description: A dark, campy, and hilarious supernatural comedy about eternal youth, sharing the wicked, magical charm of Practical Magic.

metas.name: Enola Holmes
metas.description: A breezy, lighthearted mystery-adventure with a charming fourth-wall-breaking lead, perfect for fans of cozy, fun puzzles.

metas.name: Guardians of the Galaxy
metas.description: A space-opera adventure that leans heavily into comedy, classic music, and a lovable group of misfits, sharing the exact DNA of Thor: Ragnarok.

metas.name: 21 Jump Street
metas.description: An incredibly self-aware, chaotic buddy-cop comedy that delivers non-stop laughs, perfect for fans of Ace Ventura and The Nice Guys.

metas.name: A Simple Favor
metas.description: A stylish, twisty, and darkly comedic mystery thriller that will appeal to fans of Get Shorty and the Knives Out franchise.

metas.name: Palm Springs
metas.description: A brilliant sci-fi romantic comedy about a time loop that is as existential as it is hilarious, matching the whimsical romance of your watchlist.

metas.name: Rye Lane
metas.description: A vibrant, colorful, and fast-paced modern rom-com set in London that recaptures the pure, lighthearted joy of classic 90s teen movies.

metas.name: About Time
metas.description: A heartwarming romantic comedy with a touch of time-travel magic, offering a cozy and deeply comforting viewing experience.

metas.name: National Treasure
metas.description: The ultimate fun, low-stakes adventure movie filled with historical puzzles, action, and humor, matching the spirit of D&D.

metas.name: The Lost City
metas.description: A delightful jungle adventure rom-com that heavily channels the self-aware, lighthearted comedic style of Jumanji.

metas.name: Kingsman: The Secret Service
metas.description: A highly stylized, fun, and energetic action-spy movie that doesn't take itself too seriously, appealing to fans of high-octane fun.

metas.name: Crazy Rich Asians
metas.description: A lavish, extremely colorful, and romantic comfort watch with a great comedic ensemble, perfect for a relaxing movie night.

metas.name: The Grand Budapest Hotel
metas.description: A whimsical, visually stunning caper comedy with a stellar cast, appealing to the eccentric, historical comedy vibe of Nouvelle Vague.

metas.name: Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy
metas.description: An iconic, quotation-filled absurdist comedy that matches the ridiculous, over-the-top energy of Ace Ventura and Brüno.

metas.name: Amélie
metas.description: A whimsical, beautifully shot French romantic comedy that shares the surreal, dreamlike charm of Night Is Short, Walk On Girl.

metas.name: Shazam!
metas.description: A superhero movie with the heart of 'Big', focusing on fun, family, and comedy rather than dark stakes, similar to Thor: Ragnarok.

metas.name: Grosse Pointe Blank
metas.description: A clever 90s dark comedy about a hitman attending his high school reunion, sharing the cool, witty crime-comedy energy of Get Shorty.

metas.name: Enchanted
metas.description: A delightful Disney musical-fantasy parody that sends up classic fairy tales, offering pure, unadulterated comfort and joy.

metas.name: Galaxy Quest
metas.description: A brilliant sci-fi comedy that lovingly parodies space adventures, delivering the same misfit-ensemble magic as D&D: Honor Among Thieves.
